snippet.title: Space Waves // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808140/Space_Waves/

Space Waves is a procedurally generated 2D arcade style shooter with multiple collectable power ups and varying enemy types. This game will casually draw you in and then increase the pace and difficulty as you progress through the never ending levels.

Developed by 
Paul Connor
